_README: Manual cycling leader override. One entry per live cycling event. eventId must match the cycling event id from /api/events (e.g. cycling-grand-tour-giro-d-italia-2026, cycling-grand-tour-tour-de-france-2026, cycling-grand-tour-vuelta-a-espana-2026). Leave 'rider' empty ("") to hide the leader section on the card. 'gap' is the time gap to second place (e.g. '0:42' or '1:15'). 'stageNumber' is the stage after which the GC reflects (use null to omit).
